documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Amendments to Memorandum & Articles of Association

analysis.summary: OnEMI Technology (Kissht) reported strong FY26 results with AUM growing 73% year-on-year to ₹7,066 crore and PAT increasing 75% to ₹281 crore. Management is targeting AUM growth of over 40% for FY27 while focusing on high-quality borrower segments and reducing impairment costs. The company is expanding its secured Loan Against Property (LAP) business and has deployed 75% of its IPO proceeds into its NBFC subsidiary to support on-book capital.

guidance.claim: The company expects AUM to grow by more than 40% with a focus on disciplined asset quality and secured business scale-up.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting a gross NPA below 2.25% and a 10%-15% reduction in impairment costs.
guidance.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

guidance.claim: The company targets a return on average AUM between 4.5% and 5% and a return on average equity between 19% and 21%.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

guidance.claim: The company is cautiously optimistic about receiving a credit rating upgrade within the next 6 to 8 months.
guidance.quote: We are cautiously optimistic on getting another upgrade from both of these institutions at some point in FY27, but that is an active discussion that will happen with the course of next 6 to 8 months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the long-term structural credit opportunity in India for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is supported by economic growth and significant credit under-penetration in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing organic demand for Loan Against Property from its existing customer base.
demand_outlook.quote: More than 40% of our LAP customers come from our existing Kissht customer base, an organic demand from people who already trust us.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth momentum observed in the previous quarter has continued into April and May.
demand_outlook.quote: The short answer to your second question is Yes, the same momentum is visible.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to add at least 80 more branches for its LAP business by the end of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: A new fully-owned subsidiary has been created to distribute mutual funds and wealth products.
capex_expansion.quote: Now, it so happens if you have to distribute mutual fund, it is best done via separate entity and that is why we have created this fully-owned subsidiary for selling mutual fund and other wealth products primarily.

margins_costs.claim: The company is deliberately moderating its total income yield to target higher-quality borrower segments.
margins_costs.quote: Our total income yield as a percentage of AUM has moderated, and this is a deliberate and conscious strategy.

margins_costs.claim: Impairment costs as a percentage of average AUM decreased to 8.2% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: But the payoff is visible - our impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM has fallen from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26 and in Q4 alone, it stood at 7%.

margins_costs.claim: Funding costs are expected to decrease following a recent credit rating upgrade.
margins_costs.quote: With our recent A- credit rating in February 2026, we expect funding costs to ease meaningfully over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The Loan Against Property AUM stands at ₹518 crore across 98 branches.
orders_capacity.quote: LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has served more than 11.76 million unique customers.
orders_capacity.quote: We have served over 11.76 million unique customers till date.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an in-house collection team of over 7,000 field agents and 1,000 tele-callers.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we have over 7,000 field agents and 1,000+ tele-callers, more than 95% collections remain in-house, covering 17,000+ pin codes with swift field intervention from as early as 5 DPD.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has infused ₹630 crore of IPO proceeds as equity into its NBFC subsidiary.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% of the primary issue, approximately ₹ 630 crore have been already infused as fresh equity into our NBFC subsidiary, which is Si Creva Capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The remaining 25% of IPO proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes and long-term franchise strengthening.
capital_allocation.quote: For the balance 25%, it is earmarked for general corporate purposes and is being deployed in a calibrated manner towards areas that will strengthen the long-term franchise.

capital_allocation.claim: The NBFC subsidiary maintains a capital adequacy ratio of 25.3%.
capital_allocation.quote: In our NBFC, which is a 100% subsidiary of OnEMI Technologies, Capital adequacy remains comfortable at 25.3%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company targets a steady-state debt-to-equity leverage ratio of 2.5 to 3 for its on-book lending.
capital_allocation.quote: On the on-book lending, given that it's predominantly a personal loan right now, for us, we see the steady state leverage as being 2.5 to 3 on debt-to-equity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global factors such as oil prices, elevated rates, and currency volatility are weighing on the Indian environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company paused lending in approximately 450 pin codes due to elevated risk signals.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a measure of prudence, we reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes, where early-warning systems flagged elevated risks - while continuing to grow in high-quality segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Loan Against Property business has not yet reached breakeven and is expected to take one to two years to reach steady-state ROA.
risks_headwinds.quote: LAP continues to be a business which has not reached breakeven. And we are still probably a year or two away from being at steady state ROA.

management_commitments.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.
